alt: The HONOR Robot Phone with its mechanical gimbal arm extended, holding the camera module aloft on a folding robotic appendage
story: HONOR launched the 'Robot Phone,' a $1,930 smartphone with a mechanical folding gimbal arm that pops out of the back so the camera can stabilize itself — solving camera shake by adding a robot appendage to your pocket.
why_funny: The logical conclusion of 'we added AI stabilization' is apparently just strapping a physical robot arm to the outside of the phone.
